service.name: Client dinner and member event entertainment
service.serviceType: Live music for client dinners, member events and private clubs
service.description: Jazz duo and small ensembles for client dinners, member events and private clubs in Denver, played at conversation volume with sound support that's the right size for the venue.

faqs.q: How loud is a jazz duo during dinner?
faqs.a: Dinner and cocktail sets run 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, a level you can talk across without raising your voice. If your venue or club enforces a cap, give us the number at contract and the evening is built under it.

faqs.q: What does music for a client dinner cost?
faqs.a: It depends on how many musicians the evening needs and how long they play, and for a dinner that's usually two musicians for two or three hours. We don't publish prices; what live music costs across this market is set out on our pricing page. Tell us the date and roughly how many are sitting down, and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price.

faqs.q: Can you invoice against a purchase order?
faqs.a: Yes. We can be set up as a vendor and quote against a PO, with the purchase order number on one itemised invoice. The certificate of insurance and the W-9 come with the contract.

faqs.q: Does the music stop for toasts and remarks?
faqs.a: Yes, before the speaker reaches the microphone. Toasts, introductions and remarks get an announcement microphone of their own, and transitions are planned with your run of show.

faqs.q: How much space does the duo need?
faqs.a: An 8 by 6 foot corner, one dedicated 20-amp circuit, and a 60-minute load-in. No stage and no house sound system are required: sound support that's the right size for the venue is included at every size, and the footprint for every size up to quartet is published on the technical page.
